files.description: EHI Export documentation page (HTML). Single-page documentation describing the (b)(10) export mechanism, format (ZIP with CSVs/PDFs/PNGs), data categories included (demographics, clinical, billing, documents), and export generation process. This is the primary and only EHI export documentation artifact.
